generators.name: Capability Gap Scanner
generators.method: Find tasks where frontier agents reason well but lack live data, exhaustive measurement, persistence, deterministic action, or verification.

generators.name: Pricing Mismatch Scanner
generators.method: Find occasional-use paid utilities whose marginal execution cost is near zero and whose subscription model is poorly matched to usage.

generators.name: ChatGPT Gap Crawler
generators.method: Find prompts where ChatGPT reasons well but lacks live data, proprietary data, specialist algorithm, verification, or action. Classify per openaifinal.md section 9. Discard anything ChatGPT does natively.

ideas.name: Domain Intelligence
ideas.problem: Agents can invent names but cannot reliably establish live availability, renewal price, history and conflicts at scale.

ideas.name: Scientific Naming Experiments
ideas.problem: Domain naming is currently a creative guessing exercise. No one measures semantic transmission, agent preference, or category elasticity empirically.

ideas.name: Redirect Chain Primitive
ideas.problem: A deterministic network primitive is repeatedly packaged behind bloated SEO products.

ideas.name: Generic PDF Summarizer
ideas.problem: Generic PDF summarization is already native to frontier models.

ideas.name: HandleChecker
ideas.problem: Agents can invent brand names but cannot verify live cross-platform username availability (GitHub, X, npm, PyPI, TikTok, etc.) in one call. Gap: cross-platform username truth.

ideas.name: FitChecker
ideas.problem: Agents cannot answer 'does this part fit this machine' without a compatibility graph. Gap: parts compatibility.

ideas.name: CompanyChecker
ideas.problem: Agents cannot verify UK company/name availability against Companies House at conversation time. Gap: UK company and name availability.

ideas.name: StockChecker
ideas.problem: Agents cannot see live local supplier stock before promising availability. Gap: local supplier stock truth.

ideas.name: MarketPrice
ideas.problem: Agents cannot quote marketplace historical pricing to answer 'what is this worth'. Gap: marketplace historical pricing.

ideas.name: ShipQuote
ideas.problem: Agents cannot produce a live shipping quote without carrier rate access. Gap: shipping quote execution.

ideas.name: PropertyCheck
ideas.problem: Agents cannot return verified property facts (tenure, EPC, planning history) in one call. Gap: property facts.

ideas.name: ComplianceCheck
ideas.problem: Agents cannot deterministically verify product compliance against rules where hallucination is fatal. Gap: product compliance verification.

ideas.name: SupplierCheck
ideas.problem: Agents cannot verify whether a supplier is trustworthy (registration, history, risk signals) at decision time. Gap: supplier verification.

ideas.name: ProductMatch
ideas.problem: Agents cannot match a retail SKU to its wholesale/supplier equivalent. Gap: SKU matching across supplier graphs.

ideas.name: QuoteCheck
ideas.problem: Agents cannot benchmark a contractor quote against live local pricing to answer 'what should I charge/pay'. Gap: quote benchmarking. Related: decision.kitchen_auditor (KitchenQuoteAuditor, ideabank) — kitchen-specific decision engine; this is the agent-facing primitive.

ideas.name: StackCheck
ideas.problem: Agents cannot deterministically report what technology a website runs on. Gap: website technology detection.

ideas.name: ServiceFinder
ideas.problem: Agents cannot answer 'get me an electrician tomorrow' without live local provider availability. Gap: real local service availability.
